name: Inflection Live-Portal Data Drift Remediation
description: Routine Inflection pipeline-correctness cleanup. Triggered by one observation 2026-05-15 -- the Segment Analytics WA account count read 685 then 744; the investigation answered it: 744 is correct, 685 was a defective 06:00 build being corrected (not a methodology change; INF_D_04 code unchanged since 2026-05-14). Underneath sit two genuine small fixes worth carrying to closure: (1) the 06:00 daily cron mis-times -- CHAIN_INCREMENTAL omits INF_B_00 (canonical_holdings), so the portal serves short-holdings numbers most of every day until an on-demand full chain runs (a one-line cron-timing fix; AE 0.6.1); (2) an append-only date gate froze the INF_C_02/C_03 gold timeseries (~$787K timeseries-vs-snapshot gap; durable patch already shipped 2f580143f, DS~A). Plus minor INF_D_04 client_portal_summary.py internal-consistency cleanup (geo state-vs-sum-of-cities, a histogram excluded-count, radial_12m partial-decomposition labeling, a dual client_count source). Not an urgent project -- ordinary pipeline fixes; framing right-sized per the CTO ruling 2026-05-15.
